cover.prompt: Inside the Tholos of Schedia: a circular hall of honey limestone with an intricate floor of alternating white marble and dark limestone lozenges, six fluted columns supporting heavy timber roof rafters, and stone benches along the red-painted wall where legislators sit at their tablet stands; through the open porch doorway the bay and distant mountains are visible under clear morning sunlight.

r.prompt: Far below the roof, tholos-runner comes in through the bright doorway, and liskovia sits at her bench by the wall.

schedia.prompt: Schedia from across the calm waters of the bay: stone houses with terracotta tile roofs climbing the rocky hillside from the harbour quay, and on its paved terrace above the water stands the Tholos under a conical tiled roof with a lantern and porch, as the blue Aegean sea stretches out in morning light.

r.prompt: Nobody is visible at this distance.

benches.prompt: Looking across the geometric marble and limestone floor of the Tholos of Schedia towards the curved marble benches along the red-painted wall, each bench equipped with a stone stand holding wax tablets, stylus, and a bronze seal kit.

r.prompt: Across the hall, okios sits at his bench writing; halfway across the floor tholos-runner walks towards him carrying a wax tablet.

bench.prompt: Close on a curved stone bench against the red-painted drum of the Tholos of Schedia: on the carved stone stand beside it rests a stack of smoothed wax tablets, a bronze stylus, and a modular bronze signet seal kit.

r.prompt: melissa sits on her bench writing on a wax tablet, a stack of blank tablets on the stand beside her.
